limitations: Exclusive checking is opt-in for en-US, en-GB, en-AU, en-CA, and en-IN. Provider selection is profile-wide, so native spelling for those dialects is also disabled in Calc and Impress, where LibreHarp does not run.
Validated on Linux x86-64 with LibreOffice 26.8.
installation: Installed into the existing shared LibreOffice installation after explicit user approval. English-only mode enabled in the normal profile and verified after restart. Personal preferences checksum unchanged; previous checker choices saved for restoration.
